UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated CloudNote user profile stored privately under their user ID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth user UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User's display name shown in the dashboard.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

Note.title: Note
Note.description: A cloud-synchronized note owned by a specific authenticated user.

isPinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to the top of the dashboard.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Subcollection storing all cloud notes belonging to the user.
